title: Injective area formula on an open Lipschitz domain, in integral form
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, B ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ K-Lipschitz on B (K ∈ ℝ≥0) and injective on B, and g : ℝᴺ → ℝ continuous. Then ∫_{ψ(B)} g dHⁿ = ∫_B g(ψ(v))·Jψ(v) dLⁿ(v), where Jψ(v) := normDet(Dψ(v)) with Dψ(v) = fderiv ℝ ψ v, Hⁿ = μHE[n] and Lⁿ = volume; both sides are Bochner integrals (no integrability assumption).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0), IsOpen B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → InjOn ψ B → ∀ g : Rn N → ℝ, Continuous g → ∫ y in ψ '' B, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫ v in B, g (ψ v) * (fderiv ℝ ψ v).toLinearMap.normDet
